headline: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 reaches 80.27% matched code
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 rises from 78.63% to 80.27% matched code, with 4,291 of 5,109 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. US-to-PAL adaptations, the debug-menu drawing routine and pickup behaviour land alongside smaller implementations (#50, #55, #49, #53).
highlights: Shared level code becomes one report unit, without changing the coverage totals merely by regrouping it (#52).
#51's author ran focused function and file checks rather than a full build.
#54 proposes a memory-card menu state handler that lets the native New Game path reach Veldin. It has not merged.
Further functional C for the port is kept separate from exact-match progress (#55).
